briefdescription.para: Computes the intersection of the diagonal.

detaileddescription.para:
This implements the DiagonalIntersection algorithm. Additional details can be found in:
Odeh et al., "Merge Path - Parallel Merging Made Simple", 2012
Odeh et al., "Merge Path - A Visually Intuitive Approach", 2014, URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/1406.2628
The number of elements merged from the first sequence. The number from the second is diag minus the returned value.
